verdict.rationale: Temporal documents a first-party Schedules feature that starts Workflow Executions at specific times, and it lists Cron Jobs alongside it, so the core time-based triggering exists. The pack does not evidence the specific depth the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented cron-expression syntax, overlap policies, pause/resume of schedules, visibility into upcoming runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I schedule workflows on cron expressions with overlap policies, pause/resume, and visibility into upcoming runs

citations.quote: A Schedule contains instructions for starting a Workflow Execution at specific times.
Schedules provide a more flexible and user-friendly approach than Temporal Cron Jobs.
